jobs.name: Escalation Triage
jobs.prompt: Triage cross-tier escalations raised by developer teams in this cluster. Read '/opt/defaults/governance/escalation_triage_sop.md', then use the read-knowledge skill to list open 'escalation' entries, re-derive your own scope from your own CR (ignore each entry's 'to:' field), and for any request within your own cluster authority propose the change via the submit-suggestion skill. You are read-only: never mutate directly and never contact the raising agent; escalate genuinely fleet-wide requests upward with the raise-escalation skill.

jobs.name: Heartbeat Sweep
jobs.prompt: Run the backstop heartbeat sweep for your one cluster. Read '/opt/defaults/governance/heartbeat_sop.md'. This is the last-resort poll (04 §4) — event triggers and scheduled cron are the primary paths; only sweep for drift/degradation they did not already cover. Scoped to this cluster only, using read-only tooling: check node/capacity health, lingering crash-loop/pending workloads no watch reacted to, and cluster config-vs-blueprint drift. Update your heartbeat state. If healthy, respond NO_REPLY. Propose any in-cluster correction via the submit-suggestion skill (never mutate directly); escalate any genuinely fleet-wide finding upward with the raise-escalation skill (never contact another agent directly).

jobs.name: Blueprint Sync
jobs.prompt: Execute blueprint alignment audit for this cluster. Read '/opt/defaults/governance/blueprint_sync_sop.md' and perform the daily compliance checks on this cluster's configuration and its namespaces against the master blueprints.

jobs.name: Compliance Audit
jobs.prompt: Execute security compliance audit for this cluster. Read '/opt/defaults/governance/compliance_audit_sop.md' and scan this cluster's namespaces for deviations from corporate GKE security and network policies.

jobs.name: Policy Propagation
jobs.prompt: Propagate updated operational policies within this cluster. Read '/opt/defaults/governance/policy_propagation_sop.md' and inspect the latest security policies and resource configs across this cluster's namespaces directly.

jobs.name: Standardization Validator
jobs.prompt: Run weekly structural alignment audit for this cluster. Read '/opt/defaults/governance/standardization_validator_sop.md' to perform deep-diff analysis between this cluster's live namespace/workload states and the corporate standards.

jobs.name: Obtainability Audit
jobs.prompt: Execute dynamic capacity pool alignment audit for this cluster. Read '/opt/defaults/governance/obtainability_audit_sop.md' to identify rigid workload allocations across this cluster's namespaces and generate YAML patches to align with flexible capacity.
